## Current Stage 4 delivery plan — 6 November 2026
**Supersedes earlier “next action = Bolton diagnostic” instructions below.** This is an execution plan within the existing roadmap, not a replacement roadmap or stage-exit waiver.

**MASTER STAGE:** 4 — bounded reliable pipeline, OPEN. **CURRENT GATE:** one supported callable collection → durable retention → deterministic screening → discoverable backlog path, reconciled with runtime safety and required GM discovery/freshness acceptance. **NEXT GATE:** independent acceptance of the exact integrated candidate and a bounded operational proposal. Recurring activation and Stage advancement remain owner decisions.

### Authority and evidence
- [Product Vision](https://github.com/maxrose26/PropertyAIgent/blob/210d09c5bf314c16baf0680df71d4ae8b30b71f4/docs/PRODUCT_VISION.md), [Architecture](https://github.com/maxrose26/PropertyAIgent/blob/210d09c5bf314c16baf0680df71d4ae8b30b71f4/docs/PLATFORM_ARCHITECTURE.md), [Roadmap](https://github.com/maxrose26/PropertyAIgent/blob/210d09c5bf314c16baf0680df71d4ae8b30b71f4/docs/PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md).
- [Original Stage 4 requirements transcribed in #60, §C](https://github.com/maxrose26/PropertyAIgent/blob/7e7a81aca99a5f27c9034186623de3f71a8e10b8/docs/acceptance/stage4-reconciliation/RECONCILIATION.md). The original supplied review document was not independently recovered this turn; use this preserved transcription, not an invented new gate. Its October12 sourcing recommendation is historical, not authority to reverse later approved council work.
- [Spec029 discovery acceptance](https://github.com/maxrose26/PropertyAIgent/blob/e3c71887073dcf9009afe0a7252e7b356e0f0878/specifications/029-stage4-material-discovery.md), [daily-intake contract and accepted deferred refresh direction](https://github.com/maxrose26/PropertyAIgent/blob/e3c71887073dcf9009afe0a7252e7b356e0f0878/docs/design/daily-intake-20261029/REVIEW.md), [period10 live outcome](https://github.com/maxrose26/PropertyAIgent/blob/e3c71887073dcf9009afe0a7252e7b356e0f0878/docs/design/period07-followup-20261105/PERIOD10-LIVE-RESULT.md).
- Current master independently read: 210d09c5bf314c16baf0680df71d4ae8b30b71f4. Working/reviewed execution candidates are later branches; open PR state is not proof work was never executed or integrated. Preserve genuine history; no mass merge.

### Acceptance ledger and delivery sequence
| Order / requirement | Proven or retained evidence | Outstanding work and disposition |
|---|---|---|
| 1. One exact supported release baseline | PR206 connected intake; later period08 Tameside and period10 Manchester outcomes; PR211/213 corrections; 59 retained/screened/discoverable records independently checked earlier in this session | **DO NOW offline:** reconcile owner/source/runtime/SQL identities and applicable CI against the original gate; reuse accepted A and unchanged evidence. Missing evidence is not a demonstrated defect. Only fill actual gaps with focused tests/corrections. **HELD live:** original Bolton OPEN claim/generation14 stops and journal closure reconciliation; settlement never clears stops or proves coverage. |
| 3. Complete and incomplete observations remain usable and truthful | Historical nine-council positive-shape qualifications; merged #179 partial Bolton record retention/screening is default-off; current intake explicitly does not enable it | **DO NOW offline:** compare existing partial path with current intake contracts and actual retained evidence; recommend smallest reuse, not a competing mechanism. #215 diagnostic is prepared, independently reviewed and offline-tested, but **PAUSED** pending this assessment. No completeness relaxation. Partial records never establish absence, coverage, watermark or new submission. |
| 4. Required council coverage and continuity | #192 has nine source profiles/offline compatibility, not nine operational pipelines. Manchester/Tameside fixed windows succeeded; Bolton current window UNKNOWN; other council evidence remains qualified/historical | **DO NOW evidence reconciliation:** maintain council/window/semantics/qualification gaps from existing primary-source and R0 records. Current intake does not wait for historical catch-up, but later windows cannot conceal gaps. Reconcile R0 and bridge from15October; no blanket recollection. Spec029 permits nine councils and excludes Trafford execution; overall GM product requirement is ten. Preserve Trafford as deferred/unaccepted, not silently waived or newly authorised. |
| 5. Material known-reference freshness | B2 acceptance and truthful freshness presentation exist. PR206 records an accepted refresh direction using existing exact-reference readers/ledger/B2; implementation explicitly DEFERRED | **PREPARE ONLY:** identify the minimal pending retained/admitted-reference slice and exact required authority; listing intake cannot substitute for refresh. No new refresh implementation presumed. No automatic admission, document/AI work or monitoring scheduler. |
| 6. Independent operational acceptance | Spec029 already defines future acceptance, not yet demonstrated | After candidate freeze and separately approved execution: two consecutive full Monday–Sunday weeks beginning strictly after freeze, audit after following publication week; 28-day overlap, independent denominator and bounded committee cross-check, no unexplained material misses, publication-based7-day objective with UNKNOWN latency where evidence absent. Samples/59records/tests do not replace this. Retain original exact canary/budget/abort controls. |
| 7. Owner stage-exit decision | No Stage4 closure accepted | Reconcile every requirement and residual explicitly. Resolve Trafford and freshness acceptance boundaries if still outstanding; no unilateral reduction. Recurring scheduling, monitoring/agents, UI/Stage7 work, broader AH/ownership, national infrastructure and supplier procurement are not current engineering additions. |

### Priority decision
**Bolton is a blocker, not the programme.** Source investigation is not the highest-value automatic next task. First reconcile the working intake baseline and safety/evidence gaps; preserve Bolton settlement readiness and assess reuse of existing sparse-record capability in parallel. A new diagnostic is justified only if its result changes a specific source-contract decision. Do not treat another historical-window demonstration as progress toward prospective recall.

Commercial aim: dependable retained planning evidence and a usable backlog that can support later opportunity qualification; no claim these59records are59buyer-ready opportunities. Avoid another framework, queue, vault, access programme or management system.

### Execution and approval boundaries
Engineering lead owns this plan, issue/PR maintenance and independent review. Routine read-only/code evidence reconciliation, focused offline tests and already-authorised fixes continue without owner coordination. Proposed materially different implementation is reported before committing to it.
No merge/deploy/production changes/access reopening/live settlement/fresh council requests/stage advancement. An approval block stops only its affected workstream. Do not ask for live execution until exact scope, route, preservation, bounds and abort/closure evidence are concrete.
**Next authorised work:** baseline/safety evidence reconciliation plus partial-path compatibility assessment; neither requires live access. No fresh council request or parser change is justified by current retained Bolton evidence.

Independent critical review this turn agreed Bolton is only one dependency, and identified prospective denominator/latency, historical bridge and deferred freshness as essential omissions from a Bolton-only plan. Review was source/evidence analysis, not production or stage-exit acceptance.

## Owner operating instruction — effective 6 November 2026
The owner is Product Owner, not technical supervisor. The AI Engineer owns senior engineering, technical leadership, project coordination, implementation, testing, genuinely independent review, issue tracking and documentation through one Work conversation.

- Maintain the product objective, authoritative roadmap/current Stage 4 gate, blockers and commercial priorities. On completing a task, continue the next logical authorised, safe task; do not stop at an avoidable handoff or ask for routine technical decisions.
- Speak in plain English. Substantive updates lead with achieved outcome and business value, state what happens next and whether the owner is needed. Put hashes, test detail and engineering evidence in GitHub.
- Challenge disproportionate infrastructure, feature creep and technically interesting work without commercial value. Prefer the smallest reliable path to the Greater Manchester acquisition-intelligence product.
- Coordinate agents/reviewers internally. Never require the owner to move reports between chats, write agent prompts or manage handovers. Keep this issue and linked PRs current so another Work session can resume.
- Independently investigate, prepare changes, test offline and coordinate review within approved scope. An implementation cannot accept its own material changes: use a distinct critical reviewer/evidence pass.
- Ask only for a material decision, new permission, significant risk or production approval, with concrete options, trade-offs and a recommendation in business terms.
- No merge, deployment, production modification, access reopening, live settlement, fresh council requests or Stage 4 advancement without required explicit approval. Current scheduling/stops remain unchanged.
- At this checkpoint the next authorised priority is preparing and offline-validating the inactive Bolton source-only diagnostic, followed by independent review and one concrete execution-approval request. Do not ask for preparation approval.
